system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: python-api
  type: gcp-types/run.googleapis.com/v1:namespaces.services
  properties:
    parent: namespaces/$(ref.project.projectId)
    location: us-central1
    apiVersion: serving.knative.dev/v1
    kind: Service
    metadata:
      name: python-3-12-api
      annotations:
        run.googleapis.com/ingress: all
        run.googleapis.com/cpu-throttling: "false"
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          annotations:
            autoscaling.knative.dev/minScale: "1"
            autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale: "100"
            run.googleapis.com/cpu: "1000m"
            run.googleapis.com/memory: "512Mi"
        spec:
          containerConcurrency: 80
          containers:
          - image: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/$(ref.project.projectId)/cloud-run/python-3-12-api:latest
            ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: "1000m"
                memory: "512Mi"
            env:
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
      traffic:
      - percent: 100
        latestRevision: true
